local_adapter: Source mechanical body/assets/contact parameters/mass/inertia/internal camera; rigid distal Panda mount with stock fingers retained. Original legacy depth with fliplr, immutable source baseline, MLP weights, smoothing/shadow and MarkerMotion. CPU/private imports/NumPy mat compatibility only. Per-sensor rigid-object relative pose endpoints, reset on loss/change of contact. No multi-object flow superposition: multiple bodies explicitly report unsupported flow while RGB/depth continue. Source physics options except task gravity and 0.5 ms runner step; diagnostic probe uses implicitfast for its own servo. No local depth gain, reanchoring, flow cap, unloading zeros or AnySkin profile.
task_integration: Selectable alone in all Panda tasks; shared keyboard/SpaceMouse/Pico software and LeRobot recording. Elastic clip tasks explicitly use MuJoCo discrete spring integration; source sensor contact settings/optical functions unchanged. Other tasks retain source integration. Diagnostic six-axis probe uses critical translational damping for its 20 g/3000 N/m servo, not a changed sensor material.
